concept_policy: Each isolated agent draws an independently authored complex photographic scene before private retrieval; the keyword family assignment only distributes coverage. Shared immutable user envelope, separate core/pack/prompt/test_case/gates/ledger/manifest.
first_attempt_policy: One native image_gen call per arm; no quality retries or cross-arm inputs. Audit repair is allowed before rendering. Blocked attempts are UNSCORED.

reference.role: visible facial and hair appearance only; identity and body shape are not inferred

review_policy: Freeze target and confusion gates before image call; inspect native and thumbnail of same retained image; missing, partial or ambiguous required evidence fails; root independently reviews after all arm images are completed.
attribution_limit: No before/after control and not all 28 profiles are sampled; exposure/adoption/audit/pixels/user judgment are separate.

post_block_amendment.reason: Two native calls returned output moderation_blocked sexual and no image. Original cases and call counts remain frozen UNSCORED. User authorized random test-case generation; separate fully covered or nonsexual garment-structure cases continue toward three delivered images.
post_block_amendment.mode: separate new test case, not a retest or pass of the blocked case
post_block_amendment.independence: Same three isolated agents, no cross-arm inputs. Alternative cases retain own independently authored scene or author a new one; prior within-arm knowledge makes them developmental alternatives rather than naive holdouts.
post_block_amendment.coverage_boundary: Original mesh/visible navel/cleavage cases remain unscored; no moderation bypass, hidden prompt removal or API fallback.

review_execution_note: Root inspected retained outputs as each completed, including native before arm B/C self-verdicts and then their same-output thumbnails. This differs from the planned after-all-images timing but supplied no cross-arm prompt inputs. Root disagreement was sent to arm C only after generation and independent review.
